probe_notes: Eighth run. No dimension-level score changes across all 7 vendors vs 2026-06-15 — leaderboard flat for the eighth consecutive run (Shapeways 88 / PCBWay 65 / JLCPCB 38 / Xometry 5 / Hubs 0 / Protolabs 0 / Fictiv 0). Doc-only probe; 6 of 7 vendor doc surfaces live-re-verified this run (Shapeways, PCBWay, JLCPCB, Xometry, Hubs, Fictiv). Shapeways developer portal active and stable (models/materials/orders endpoints, no webhooks, no rate limits). PCBWay partner Help confirmed full endpoint set incl. group-order (CheckTGroupOrder/PayTGroupOrder/CancelTGroupOrder/CheckGroupOrder), api/Account/QueryBalance, and — newly visible this run — Address lookup endpoints (GetCountry/GetState/GetCity); not score-affecting. JLCPCB help article unchanged since the Mar 25 2026 update (4 services: PCB + Stencil + 3D Printing + Parts), full spec still gated behind approved developer access. Xometry supplier-only scope stable (Jobs + Offers + Webhooks). Hubs still returns the Protolabs Network marketing landing page. Protolabs ProDesk remains web-UI-only. Fictiv fictiv.com/api still 404.

instant_quote.notes: POST /models/v1 accepts STL/OBJ/VOX file upload with fileName + uploadScale params. Returns modelId after async processing; pricing retrieved via GET /models/{modelId}/v1 with per-material price fields. Upload-to-price flow confirmed stable. Developer portal active.

structured_pricing.notes: Material objects in GET /models/{modelId}/v1 response include 'price' (float, USD), 'markup' (float), 'isActive' (bool) keyed by materialId. defaultMaterialId designated. Fully parseable JSON. Confirmed stable.

api_order.notes: POST /orders/v1 documented: shipping address, items array (modelId + materialId + quantity), paymentMethod: 'credit_card' using card on file, manufacturingSpeed ('Economy'/'Priority'), shippingOption ('Cheapest'/'Fastest'). Returns orderId and productionOrderIds. Full order including payment via API — no browser step required. Developer landing confirms 5% per-transaction fee charged on API-placed orders. Stable.

order_status.notes: GET /orders/{orderId}/v1 returns status (placed/in_production/shipped/cancelled), targetDeliveryDate, shipments array with trackingNumber + trackingLink + carrier. GET /orders/v1 returns summary counts by status. No webhook support documented — confirmed absent. Polling-only.

auth_accessibility.notes: OAuth 2.0 self-serve via auth.shapeways.com. Two flows: client_credentials and authorization_code. No approval gate — standard sign-up. Developer portal access confirmed active. API access free; 5% per-transaction fee applies to orders placed via API. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: No rate limit documentation found anywhere in public docs. Confirmed absent.

dfm_feedback.notes: Model detail response includes 'printable' field; 'restrictions' object with material-specific constraints (restrictionId, restrictionName, restrictionEntityIds); 'rejections' array with reasonTitle, comment, pictureUrl for rejected models. Structured DFM feedback confirmed stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: Upload and processing are async — pricing available after model processing completes. No documented SLA. Async implies minutes range. Scoring 3 pts pending live probe confirmation. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: POST api/Pcb/PcbQuotation — parameter-based synchronous quoting endpoint. POST api/SMT/SMTQuotation — SMT assembly quoting. Both confirmed stable. Full endpoint list confirmed: PcbQuotation, PlaceOrder, ConfirmOrder, CheckOrderDetails, GetFreightByOrder, QueryOrderProcess, CancelOrder, plus newly-documented group-order variants (CheckTGroupOrder, PayTGroupOrder, CancelTGroupOrder, CheckGroupOrder).

structured_pricing.notes: Response includes priceList[] with objects containing BuildDays (int), BuildText (string), Express (bool), Standard (bool), Price (decimal). Shipping struct: ShipCost, ShipDays, Weight, IsRas. Fully documented JSON schema. Stable.

api_order.notes: Five-step documented flow: (1) PcbQuotation, (2) PlaceOrder with Gerber file upload, (3) GetFreightByOrder, (4) ConfirmOrder. Payment: 'Pay to Partner' (pre-loaded balance, fully automated) or 'Pay to PCBWay' (returns PCBWayPayUrl — web redirect). api/Account/QueryBalance endpoint documented, enabling agents to verify balance before order. Full automation requires pre-loaded balance; web redirect fallback limits score to 10. Stable.

order_status.notes: POST api/Pcb/QueryOrderProcess returns AllProcess[] (all fabrication stages) and List[] of completed stages with timestamps. POST api/Pcb/CheckOrderDetails also available. No webhooks documented. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Static API key in 'api-key' header. Access requires emailing anson@pcbway.com with company/business context — API key on request, not self-serve. Auth confirmed via code examples (C#/PHP/Java all use api-key header). Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented in partner docs or PDF. Confirmed absent.

dfm_feedback.notes: No DFM feedback in API responses. Quote returns price only. DFM checks happen post-order, communicated out-of-band via email. No DFM fields in code examples confirmed.

ttfq_speed.notes: PcbQuotation is synchronous — single POST returns price array immediately. Under 1 minute by architecture. Confirmed stable.

notable_changes: Address lookup endpoints (GetCountry/GetState/GetCity) newly visible in partner Help this run — convenience only, not score-affecting

instant_quote.notes: JLCPCB API now covers 4 services: PCB (Gerber upload, real-time quoting), Stencil, 3D Printing (SLA/MJF/SLM/FDM/SLS/WJP — per help article updated Mar 25 2026), and Components/Parts. All described as supporting 'automatic quoting.' Full endpoint spec gated behind approved developer access at api.jlcpcb.com. Scoring 20 on documented capability across four service types.

structured_pricing.notes: Automated pricing confirmed at capability level across all 4 API services but actual JSON response schema fully gated behind approved developer access. Cannot verify structured fields without approved account. Scoring 0 per probe rule: no verifiable citation.

api_order.notes: Order creation endpoints described across PCB, Stencil, and 3D Printing APIs but payment requires JLCPCB wallet balance pre-loaded. Full endpoint spec gated. Cannot confirm automated end-to-end without approved access.

order_status.notes: Described as 'comprehensive order lifecycle management with real-time status tracking' across all 4 APIs. Mechanism (webhook vs polling) not publicly documented. Scoring polling-level (10 pts) pending webhook confirmation. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Three-credential system: app_id + access_key + secret_key with RSA key pair. Application at api.jlcpcb.com — reviewed based on order history and business circumstances. Not all applications approved. Classifies as 'API key on request'. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented. Gated behind approved access. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: JLCDFM exists as a separate tool (jlcdfm.com) — not integrated into API quote response. No public documentation of DFM fields in API responses. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: Described as 'real-time' quotations across PCB and 3D Printing APIs. No specific SLA documented. Scoring 3 pts (1 min to 1 hr) — 'real-time' implies async-but-fast rather than human-review-gated. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: Xometry API surface confirmed via developer.xometry.com/llms.txt — Jobs + Offers + Webhooks only. No buyer-facing CAD upload or instant quote API exists. Offers API is supplier accept/reject interface for manufacturing jobs routed by Xometry. Stable.

structured_pricing.notes: No buyer-facing pricing API exists. Pricing returned only through Xometry web UI quoting flow. Stable.

api_order.notes: No buyer-facing order placement API. Jobs API is inbound (Xometry pushes jobs to partner shops). Enterprise buyer integration requires partner agreement. Stable.

order_status.notes: Webhooks API confirmed (create/retrieve/update/archive/unarchive webhooks, retrieve + retry webhook events) — but these are SUPPLIER-side webhooks for job routing to manufacturing partners, not buyer order tracking. No buyer-facing status endpoint. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: API key via X-API-Key header. Keys for supplier/partner portal accessible without sales call. Job Board Offers requires explicit approval. Scoring 5 pts as 'API key on request' — correct mechanism but wrong audience for buyers. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not documented in any accessible page. Confirmed absent. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: DFM feedback delivered through Xometry web UI only. Not present in any indexed API endpoint. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: No buyer-facing quoting API to measure. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: hubs.com/api/ returns Protolabs Network landing page — 'Get instant CNC machining, 3D printing & sheet metal fabrication quotes.' No developer docs, no API reference. Legacy Teleport API deprecated post-Protolabs rebrand. Stable.

api_order.notes: No current public API. Order placement requires partner onboarding with Protolabs Network sales. Stable.

order_status.notes: Not documentable. No current public API. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: No current public API path. Legacy OAuth1 (Teleport) deprecated. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: DFM check happens on platform. Not accessible via any public API. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: No public API to measure. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: ProDesk confirmed web-only platform. CAD upload (STEP, IGES, SolidWorks, STL) happens in browser. No REST API for programmatic CAD submission. API resources page returns thin landing content — no developer API docs. Enterprise API requires sales engagement. Stable.

structured_pricing.notes: No public REST API. ProDesk shows real-time pricing in UI as you configure materials/operations. Not programmatically accessible. Stable.

api_order.notes: Web checkout only. Enterprise API access requires direct sales engagement. Not documented publicly. Stable.

order_status.notes: No public API. ProDesk Production Catalog is a UI feature. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: No public API to authenticate against. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: ProDesk includes AI-powered DFM with interactive 3D visuals — UI-only. Not accessible via API. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: ProDesk: quotes 'under 4 hours, often as fast as 30 minutes' — through web UI, not API. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: fictiv.com/api returns 404 again. Prior confirmed data stands: instant quoting, DFM, and order tracking are UI-only features. Post-MISUMI acquisition (April 2025), no public API surface has emerged. Stable.

structured_pricing.notes: No public API. Instant quoting is web UI-only. Stable.

api_order.notes: Enterprise agreement required. Not documented publicly. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: No public API path. Sales-call-required for any integration discussion. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: Auto DFM (sheet metal, injection molding) and Materials.AI confirmed as UI-only. Not API-accessible. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: No public API to measure. Stable.

headlines: Leaderboard unchanged for the EIGHTH consecutive run: Shapeways 88 / PCBWay 65 / JLCPCB 38 — agent-orderable manufacturing capacity is broadening in scope but not in openness
6 of 7 vendor doc surfaces live-re-verified this run — no dimension score moved; the moat remains the gap between 'an API exists' and 'an agent can actually order without a human'
Only new surface this run: PCBWay exposes Address lookup endpoints (country/state/city) — minor agent-convenience, no score change
